tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.description: First-party GitHub REST bridge (Tier 1, built-in). Lets an agent read repositories, search issues, inspect gists, and star repos with scoped, auditable access through the gateway.

tools.name: Slack MCP Server
tools.description: First-party Slack Web API bridge (Tier 1, built-in). Read channel history, post messages, and look up teammates with a per-workspace token stored in the vault.

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.description: Official Notion MCP integration (Tier 2, streamable-http proxy to mcp.notion.com/mcp). Agents can search pages and databases, create documentation, and update project notes. Requires a Notion integration token.

tools.name: Stripe MCP Connector
tools.description: Official Stripe MCP connector (Tier 2, streamable-http proxy to mcp.stripe.com). Agents can look up charges, inspect customer records, and draft payment links. One-click connect via Stripe OAuth, or paste a Stripe API key.

tools.name: Firecrawl MCP Server
tools.description: Official Firecrawl hosted MCP server (Tier 2, proxied to mcp.firecrawl.dev). Agents search, scrape, and parse the web. One-click connect via Firecrawl OAuth (no key needed), or paste an fc-... API key.

tools.name: Browserbase MCP Server
tools.description: Official Browserbase hosted MCP server (Tier 2, streamable-http proxy to mcp.browserbase.com). Agents drive isolated browser sessions, navigate sites, capture screenshots, and extract page data. API key passed as the browserbaseApiKey query parameter.

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.description: Sentry MCP via stdio (Tier 3 — has no hosted endpoint; runs as a containerized npx server once Tier 2 is live). Query recent issues, inspect stack traces, and summarize crash patterns. Requires a Sentry token.

tools.name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
tools.description: PostgreSQL MCP via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized npx server: not run server-side until Tier 2 is complete). Schema inspection and parameterized queries; read-write mode controlled by the connection configuration.

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.description: Anthropic reference filesystem server via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized with a mounted, approved root). Agents can list directories and read files within admin-approved roots only. No API key; access is bound to the container's mounted volume.

tools.name: Google Drive MCP Server
tools.description: Google Drive via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized npx server, not run server-side until Tier 2 is live). Search documents, read file contents, and organize folders with OAuth-scoped access.

tools.name: Atlassian Jira MCP Server
tools.description: Jira MCP via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized npx server). Query tickets, transition issue states, log work, and generate sprint reports. Requires an Atlassian email + API token.

tools.name: Linear MCP Server
tools.description: Linear MCP via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized npx server). Create and update issues, query roadmaps, and summarize team velocity. Requires a Linear API key.

tools.name: Expensify MCP Integration
tools.description: Community-built Expensify MCP bridge via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized). Track team expenses, submit reports, and reconcile corporate card transactions. Requires an Expensify partner token.

tools.name: Zapier MCP
tools.description: Zapier MCP via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized). Trigger zaps, check run history, and connect SaaS apps through one gateway. Requires a Zapier API key.

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.description: Supabase MCP via stdio (Tier 3 — containerized npx server). Query Postgres tables, inspect schemas, and manage edge functions. Requires a Supabase access token.

tools.name: Weather
tools.description: Live current-weather lookups via Open-Meteo: get temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind speed, and conditions for any city. Tier 1 built-in, keyless, read-only.

tools.name: npm Package Lookup
tools.description: Look up an npm package by name and get its published version, description, license, links, top maintainers, and a quality/popularity/maintenance score from npms.io. Tier 1 built-in, keyless, read-only.

tools.name: PyPI Package Lookup
tools.description: Resolve any package on PyPI: latest version, summary, Python requirement, license, project links, and release history from the official PyPI JSON API. Tier 1 built-in, keyless, read-only.

tools.name: Web Search
tools.description: Keyless web search via the DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API: headline answer, definition, and related links for a query without scraping pages. Tier 1 built-in, read-only.

tools.name: GitHub (stdio bridge)
tools.description: Official GitHub reference MCP server (Tier 3 — no hosted endpoint; runs as a containerized npx server once Tier 2 is live). Requires a GitHub personal access token stored in the vault.

tools.name: Google Drive (stdio bridge)
tools.description: Google Drive MCP server (Tier 3 — no hosted endpoint; runs as a containerized npx server once Tier 2 is live). Requires Drive OAuth tokens stored in the vault.
